report_type.title: Report Type
report_type.description: Select the Xero report to extract. Choose 'Custom' for user-defined reports.

custom_report_id.title: Custom Report ID
custom_report_id.description: Required if report_type is 'Custom'. The Xero report ID or name from your custom reports.

predefined_parameters.title: Common Report Parameters
predefined_parameters.description: Standard parameters that work across most reports. Supports dynamic dates like '3 days ago', 'yesterday', 'last month'.

fromDate.title: From Date
fromDate.description: Start date. Supports: '3 days ago', 'yesterday', 'YYYY-MM-DD', 'first day of last month', etc.

toDate.title: To Date
toDate.description: End date. Supports: 'today', 'yesterday', 'YYYY-MM-DD', 'last day of last month', etc.

date.title: Date
date.description: Single date parameter for reports that use one date (e.g., Balance Sheet as of date)

periods.title: Number of Periods
periods.description: Number of periods to include in the report (typically 1-12)

trackingOptionID1.title: Tracking Category Option ID 1
trackingOptionID1.description: Filter by tracking category option (first tracking category)

trackingOptionID2.title: Tracking Category Option ID 2
trackingOptionID2.description: Filter by tracking category option (second tracking category)

standardLayout.title: Standard Layout
standardLayout.description: Use standard report layout (true) or custom layout (false)

paymentsOnly.title: Payments Only
paymentsOnly.description: Show only payment transactions (for bank reports)

custom_parameters.title: Additional Custom Parameters
custom_parameters.description: Add any report-specific parameters as key-value pairs. These will be passed directly to the Xero API.
